speaker: Doctor
text: The normal liver enzymes, ultrasound, and negative metabolic screens effectively rule out biliary atresia and galactosemia. With a total bilirubin of 16.1 mg/dL and predominantly indirect bilirubin in an exclusively breastfed infant, this presentation is classic for breast milk jaundice. DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast milk jaundice
